help.how_to_load: Admin panel > Quiz & Tools > 'Import JSON' and choose this file. The questions are ADDED to the end of the room's bank (nothing is deleted).
help.sections: [Session 1] Wh- words, do/does/did, the 'to be' exception. [Session 2] continuous, perfect, future and modals. [Session 3] subject vs object questions and prepositions at the end. [Final Challenge] mixed review.

questions.prompt: [Session 1 · Present & Past Simple] Which Wh- word asks for a LOCATION or a file path?
[Session 1 · Present & Past Simple] ____ does the antivirus scan run? — It runs every Friday at 6 PM.
[Session 1 · Present & Past Simple] ____ do you restart the database service? — You run the restart script from the terminal.
[Session 1 · Present & Past Simple] Write the missing Wh- word: ____ did the users complain? — Because the login page was too slow.
[Session 1 · Present & Past Simple] Write the missing Wh- word: ____ is responsible for the network? — Carlos, the network administrator.
[Session 1 · Present & Past Simple] Complete with do, does or did: Which browser ____ your team use every day?
[Session 1 · Present & Past Simple] Complete with do, does or did: How many emails ____ the system send last night?
[Session 1 · Present & Past Simple] Complete with do, does or did: Where ____ you usually store the test passwords?
[Session 1 · Present & Past Simple] Complete with do, does or did: What time ____ the meeting start every Monday?
[Session 1 · Present & Past Simple] Which question is CORRECT?
[Session 1 · Present & Past Simple] Fix the bug: "When did the update started?"
[Session 1 · Present & Past Simple] The "To Be" exception: Why ____ the Wi-Fi so slow yesterday?

options: Where do is the log file?
